lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: Was that the garage? That sounded like the garage.

lines.speaker: Summer
lines.text: Not it.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: Not it!

lines.speaker: Beth
lines.text: MORTY!

morty.speaker: Morty
morty.text: W-what? What did I do? I was asleep!

goals.start: Mom is yelling. Talk to Beth.
goals.garage: Go to the garage. The door is on the right.
goals.done: Episode over. Nobody touch the gun.

got.phone: GOT: SUMMER'S PHONE. PRESS Q TO READ HER NOTES.

doorNotYet.speaker: Morty
doorNotYet.text: Mom's using her yelling voice. I should talk to her first.

lines.speaker: Beth
lines.text: Oh good, you're up. Your grandfather has been in the garage since three in the morning.

lines.speaker: Beth
lines.text: Something exploded. Twice. The second one was purple.

lines.speaker: Beth
lines.text: Thank you, sweetie. Take a sandwich. Don't touch anything that hums.

lines.speaker: Beth
lines.text: It is not cool. The cat won't come out from under the couch. Go.

lines.speaker: Beth
lines.text: Fine. Don't come crying to me when the garage is on fire.

lines.speaker: Beth
lines.text: Still here? Garage. Before the third explosion.

lines.speaker: Beth
lines.text: ...And take this. You get weird when you don't eat.

lines.speaker: Beth
lines.text: Oh, now you want to talk?

lines.speaker: Beth
lines.text: Apology accepted. Barely.

lines.speaker: Beth
lines.text: Here. I made it before you were rude, so it's a good one. Don't touch anything that hums.

lines.speaker: Beth
lines.text: Garage.

lines.speaker: Beth
lines.text: Garage. Now. And if you leave the dimension, text me.

lines.speaker: Beth
lines.text: You're alive. Good. Is your grandfather alive?

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: He says he handled it.

lines.speaker: Beth
lines.text: Of course he does. There's another sandwich in the fridge.

lines.speaker: Summer
lines.text: Ugh. What.

lines.speaker: Summer
lines.text: Which one? There have been, like, four this week.

lines.speaker: Summer
lines.text: Mom said it was purple this time.

lines.speaker: Summer
lines.text: My phone? Why.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: Rick broke something. I think I need to write stuff down.

lines.speaker: Summer
lines.text: Fine. Five minutes. If you open my messages I will know.

lines.speaker: Summer
lines.text: I put the stuff you have to do in my notes app. You're welcome. Don't read the other notes.

lines.speaker: Summer
lines.text: Then why are you standing there breathing at me?

lines.speaker: Summer
lines.text: That was way more than five minutes.

lines.speaker: Summer
lines.text: A shrimp. In a lab coat. In our garage.

lines.speaker: Summer
lines.text: I got a picture. Four hundred likes already. You're not in it.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: Hey, buddy! Want to hear my new business idea?

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: A lawn chair. With a second, smaller lawn chair for your drink.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: It is NOT just a chair.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: It's a lawn chair. With a second, smaller lawn chair. For your drink.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: Watch. Fully load-tested.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: ...The small one held.

lines.speaker: Morty
lines.text: Dad, are you stuck?

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: I'm not stuck. This is the lounge setting.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: Right. Sure. Busy.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: The chair will be here when you're ready. So will I. I live here.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: Your mom sent you to the garage, huh? I'd stay out of there. Last time I lost an eyebrow.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: If you see a market for tiny lawn chairs out there, let me know.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: Morty! New idea. Shrimp-themed lawn chairs.

lines.speaker: Jerry
lines.text: The little chair holds the cocktail sauce.
